title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.01763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent

translated_title: TopK引导：面向高效大语言模型推理的自适应、预算感知激活稀疏化
translated_abstract: 激活稀疏化通过将不重要的激活值置零，从而跳过相应计算，以此加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理。然而，现有的免训练方法各有不同的取舍：基于阈值的方法（如TEAL）可以针对每个token自适应调整稀疏度，但无法严格控制实际实现的稀疏度；而基于TopK的方法（如WINA）强制执行固定的稀疏度，但对每个token都使用相同的稀疏预算。此外，尽管各个transformer块的敏感性存在很大差异，这两种方法在所有块上都应用相同的预算。我们提出TopK-Guided，这是一种免训练方法，通过将有界的token级稀疏度自适应与敏感性感知的块级预算分配相结合，解决了上述两个局限性。在Llama-2和Llama-3模型上的实验表明，TopK-Guided在困惑度和下游任务准确率上持续优于TEAL和WINA，同时保持了基本相同的稀疏度相关性能（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出免训练的激活稀疏化方法TopK-Guided，将token级自适应稀疏度调整与块级敏感性感知的预算分配相结合，在相同稀疏度下比TEAL和WINA持续降低困惑度并提升下游任务准确率。
en_tdlr: TopK-Guided is a training-free activation sparsity method that combines bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation, consistently improving perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA at comparable sparsity levels.
